Alex K: Morning — quick roundtable. Drop a 1-line: what you shipped yesterday / any blockers / plan for today. I'll compile for the sync doc.
Maria L: Shipped canary for model routing rules, observed +2% latency on tail but throughput stable. Blocker: need infra creds to rotate the test key. Today: follow up with infra + push the canary to 10% if creds done. :coffee:
Jamal R: Reviewed and approved PR #504 (batching fix). Left one nit on variable name. Blocker: need someone to approve the performance benchmark commit. Today: pair with whoever's free for perf run.
Sophie P: Drafted the customer-facing postmortem for yesterday's fallback incident, added screenshots and timeline. Blocker: waiting on ops timeline confirmation (Chris). Today: finalize & send to legal for review. :memo:
Chris T: Ops timeline added to the doc just now. Also scheduling a brief DB compaction tonight 02:00-02:30 UTC (low traffic window). Minimal impact expected. If you rely on long queries, please flag.
Priya N: Quick heads-up — codegen tests flaked in CI three times overnight. I've retried; currently green. Blocker: flaky test needs root cause. Today: dig into the test harness and add a repro script.
Maria L: @Chris T can you share the maintenance slack alert once scheduled?
Chris T: Will post at T-60 and T-10. Also posting terraform change link: https://git.redwood/infra/changes/789
Jamal R: Ping @Alex K for perf run approval window — I can start at 11:30 PT.
Alex K: 11:30 PT works. Jamal, please tag me when you start.
Deploy Bot: deploy: service/api v1.12.3 -> prod succeeded (2026-03-17T09:20:10Z). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/2026/03/17/987
Sophie P: Adding review request for postmortem in #docs in a few.
Alex K: Thanks all — compiling notes and will push a short summary to the all-hands doc. If anything blocks immediate shipping, add a 🔴 in thread.
Maria L: 🔴 infra creds is the only blocker for my rollout, pinged infra channel.
Chris T: Acknowledged, will prioritize the creds rotation after current rollout.
Alex K: Great, closing this thread — summary in 10. :)
